Databricks Technical Lead Commercial & Specialty Insurance




Years of Experience: 5-7 years




Job Summary: We are seeking an experienced Databricks Technical Lead to lead the design, architecture, and delivery of enterprise-scale data platforms supporting Commercial Property & Casualty and Specialty Insurance operations. The ideal candidate will combine deep expertise in Databricks, Spark, Cloud Data Platforms, and Modern Lakehouse Architecture with strong business knowledge across key insurance functions including Underwriting, Policy Administration, Claims, Reinsurance, Actuarial, Risk Management, and Regulatory Reporting.




Responsibilities:



Technical Leadership
Data Engineering & Lakehouse Development
Cloud & Platform Architecture
Stakeholder Engagement



Mandatory Skills:

Databricks
Apache Spark / PySpark
Delta Lake
Python
SQL
Data Warehousing
Data Modeling
Data Governance
Experience with Azure, AWS, or Microsoft Fabric ecosystems
Strong understanding of modern Lakehouse architecture patterns



Preferred Skills:

Databricks Professional Certification
Experience with Unity Catalog and enterprise data governance
Experience supporting AI/ML, GenAI, or predictive analytics initiatives
Exposure to catastrophe modeling, actuarial analytics, or risk management reporting
Experience leading global delivery teams
